label: #3594809: Use standard checkboxes on forms that require submission, pinned core
description: Compare ordinary Form API checkboxes in Default Admin. Before loads form--checkbox-toggle.css, which presents a single checkbox as a switch; After removes that stylesheet so the same native checkbox uses the existing checkbox styling. The lab fixture at /admin/lab/checkboxes shows each state; the other pages are real administration forms.
status: draft: MR !16770 as published (it empties the two stylesheets instead of deleting them); see 3594809-latest for the proposal on current core

steps.text: Standard install (Default Admin is the administration theme) plus an Article content type, an Image media type, sample content and the lab fixture form.
Compare the "Standalone checkboxes" fieldset with the "Checkbox group" below it.
steps.lookFor: Before: each standalone control is a pill-shaped switch, unlike the square boxes in the group. After: both are square checkboxes with a check mark when checked.

steps.text: Tab to "Default, unchecked" and press Space.
steps.lookFor: A visible focus indicator on the control, and the checked state changes. Nothing is saved yet.
The control is back to its saved value: the change needed Save configuration.

steps.text: Change "Default, unchecked", use Save configuration, then reload.
steps.lookFor: The saved value is kept after the reload, on both sides.
Both "Validation error" examples are marked invalid and are still recognisable as checked or unchecked.

steps.text: Check "Controlling checkbox", use Replace checkbox with AJAX, then Open checkboxes in a dialog.
steps.lookFor: The dependent checkboxes appear, become enabled and become checked; the replaced checkbox and the dialog checkboxes have the same presentation as the other standalone ones on that side.

steps.text: Visit the real forms: /admin/appearance/settings, /admin/appearance/settings/default_admin, /admin/structure/types/manage/article, /node/add/article, /admin/config/content/formats, /admin/structure/views, then the tables at /admin/modules, /admin/people/permissions, /admin/content and /admin/content/media-grid.
steps.lookFor: Single settings differ (switch Before, checkbox After). Table, grid and bulk-selection checkboxes look the same on both sides.
The control sits at the inline start (right) of its label and long labels wrap without overlapping it.

expected: Native checkboxes on forms that need Save use the existing square checkbox presentation, with the same accessible name, role, state, keyboard and pointer behaviour as before. Checkbox groups, table checkboxes and radios are unchanged.
actual: Before: Default Admin presents every standalone checkbox as a 40 by 24 pixel switch, although the value is only kept after the form is submitted. After: the same input is a 21 by 21 pixel checkbox. See EVIDENCE.md for what was measured and what a person still has to check.

checks.label: The fixture form and its first checkbox are present
The automatic switch rule (form--checkbox-toggle) is not in any loaded stylesheet
A standalone checkbox has the same box size as a checkbox in a group
Every checkbox on the page is a native checkbox with no role attribute
The standalone checkbox keeps exactly one associated label
The description is still referenced by aria-describedby
The disabled checked example is disabled and checked
The size of a checkbox in a group is the same on both sides
The form still has a Save configuration button

observe.label: Standalone checkboxes look like the checkboxes in the group, with a clear check mark when checked
Keyboard focus on a standalone checkbox is clearly visible
A change is kept only after Save configuration
Table, bulk-selection and media grid checkboxes look the same as on the other side
Long labels wrap without overlapping the control, left to right and right to left

coverage.note: The combinations that count as tested for this issue (scripts/coverage.mjs). Edit to fit the question the issue asks.
manual: Keyboard pass by a person: Tab order, Space, visible focus, focus not obscured
Pointer pass by a person: the control and its label, disabled controls
Windows High Contrast (forced colours) on a real Windows system; the lab only emulates forced-colors in Chromium
Real VoiceOver or NVDA: not run by the lab unless requested
Browser zoom at 200 and 400 percent by a person; the lab emulates the equivalent CSS viewport widths
Review of the check mark and border contrast in light and dark mode by a person
